mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in the month prior to the prediction date leads to a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of tighter policy and reduced risk appetite.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 for 3 consecutive months ending at t-1
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the identified trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coinciding with a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market tightening supports equity risk pricing.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the prior 2 months
failure_condition: Rank IC for the 60-day window exceeds 0.05 or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than a baseline of no labor signal (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in GDPC1 (real GDP) and simultaneous increase in HOUST (home sales) over the prior 3 months predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as strong demand signals robust economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative despite the signal (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) below 102 (2017=100) index triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing output suggests soft landing unlikely.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the contraction episode.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 3.0% for 4 consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver positive 20-day forward returns as market anticipates prolonged easing and lower rates.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 3.0 for 4 consecutive months ending at t-1
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during the low-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.0% followed by a sustained rise in PAYEMS predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market softens but hiring momentum builds.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS increases over the next 2 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (home sales) over the prior 2 months predict a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as dual demand channels reinforce optimism.
regime_hint: Dual retail and housing demand acceleration
failure_condition: 20-day returns are flat or negative despite the signal (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 330 (1982-1984=100) index in the month prior predicts a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as deflationary expectations weigh on equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the deflation episode.
